output.summary: VERIFIED after 2 attempt(s): 2 order(s) reviewed, 13/13 evidence items verified against Zetaris. Needs human review: L102 (missing invoice candidate), L103 (unpaid replacement invoice).

findings.explanation: Order L102 is completed but has no invoice recorded (invoice_id is null). No billing history indicates an invoice exists. The invoice may exist in a system not visible to this investigation.
findings.uncertainty: The invoice may exist in a system not visible to this investigation.
findings.recommended_action: Follow up with the billing team to locate the missing invoice for order L102.

findings.explanation: Invoice I102 for order L103 was cancelled as a duplicate (event_type INVOICE_CANCELLED, notes 'Cancelled as duplicate'). A replacement invoice I104 was issued (event_type REPLACEMENT_INVOICE_CREATED, notes 'Replacement for I102') but remains unpaid (payment_status UNPAID). Therefore the order has one replacement invoice that is outstanding.
findings.uncertainty: A payment for I104 may be recorded later; the replacement relationship is supported by the event_type and notes.
findings.recommended_action: Check payment status of replacement invoice I104 with the billing team.

recommendations.action: Follow up with the billing team to locate the missing invoice for order L102.
Check payment status of replacement invoice I104 with the billing team.

issues.problem: A missing invoice is unverified (it may exist in a system we cannot see), so confidence must be medium or low, not high.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.role: LangGraph state machine: runs attempts, routes critic feedback back to the investigator, stops at 3 attempts or the run's time budget

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Plans the data it needs, asks the Data Agent in plain language, writes evidence-backed findings under the reconciliation business rules

agents.name: Data Agent
agents.role: Turns requests into read-only SQL over the Zetaris USL table and returns the raw rows unchanged

agents.name: World Model (Meterless engine)
agents.role: Per-run register of every Zetaris row, derived link, finding and verdict, with provenance and an audit log

agents.name: Critic (code checks)
agents.role: Verifies every evidence item against the register; on failure sends concrete fixes back and skips the LLM critic

agents.name: Critic (LLM)
agents.role: Judges logic, candidate vs confirmed, replacement vs duplicate and coverage; ACCEPT or RETRY
